description: This file contains functions for exporting and importing behaviors, subjects, and project data in the BORIS behavioral observation software. It handles file dialogs, data serialization (JSON, CSV, XLSX, ODS), clipboard operations, and network requests to fetch ethogram data from a repository.

methods.name: export_project_as_pickle_object
methods.description: Exports a project dictionary as a pickle file chosen via a save file dialog.

methods.name: export_ethogram
methods.description: Exports the ethogram in various formats (BORIS, TSV, CSV, ODS, XLSX, XLS, HTML) based on user selection.

methods.name: export_subjects
methods.description: Exports the subjects list in various formats (TSV, CSV, ODS, XLSX, XLS, HTML).

methods.name: select_behaviors
methods.description: Displays a dialog for the user to select behaviors to import, filtering by categories and behavior types.

methods.name: check_text_file_type
methods.description: Determines the separator and number of fields in a list of text file rows.

methods.name: import_ethogram_from_dict
methods.description: Imports behaviors from a BORIS project dictionary, with options to append or replace existing behaviors.

methods.name: load_dataframe_into_behaviors_tablewidget
methods.description: Loads a pandas DataFrame into the behaviors table widget, verifying headers and data consistency.

methods.name: import_behaviors_from_project
methods.description: Imports behaviors from a BORIS project file, opening a file dialog and processing the project data.

methods.name: import_behaviors_from_text_file
methods.description: Imports behaviors from a CSV or TSV text file, with file dialog and delimiter detection.

methods.name: import_behaviors_from_spreadsheet
methods.description: Imports behaviors from an XLSX or ODS spreadsheet file.

methods.name: import_behaviors_from_clipboard
methods.description: Imports behaviors from clipboard content, parsing tab-separated fields.

methods.name: import_behaviors_from_JWatcher
methods.description: Imports behaviors configuration from a JWatcher GDF file.

methods.name: load_dataframe_into_subjects_tablewidget
methods.description: Loads a pandas DataFrame into the subjects table widget, verifying headers.

methods.name: import_subjects_from_clipboard
methods.description: Imports subjects from clipboard content, parsing tab-separated fields.

methods.name: import_subjects_from_project
methods.description: Imports subjects from a BORIS project file.

methods.name: import_subjects_from_text_file
methods.description: Imports subjects from a CSV or TSV text file.

methods.name: import_subjects_from_spreadsheet
methods.description: Imports subjects from an XLSX or ODS spreadsheet file.

methods.name: import_indep_variables_from_project
methods.description: Imports independent variables from another project file.
